# Lists & Galleries renews the gallery, the helix and the country pair

Owned: a leaf of #21367 until its lock, Sun 22 Nov 18:00 CET. Part 1 of Lists & Galleries: the four cards it already publishes. Part 2 (reorder by drag in a list and a card grid, `component/carousel` with images, `list/buffered` and `list/circle`) follows as its own leaf, as Charts did in two parts.

## Context

#21140's target for Lists & Galleries is 5 to 7 cards. It publishes four (`gallery`, `helix`, `covid-gallery`, `covid-helix`); `carousel` has no cover. The rows on #21142 ([comment](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21142#issuecomment-6980244557), correction 6) renew all four. Measured on `dev` 87e0ae1bc4:

- All four frames carry a "DeltaUpdates / s: 0" counter (`renderCountDeltas: true` in their `neo-config.json`) and a GitHub star button loaded from `buttons.github.io`; both helix pages add a `logDeltaUpdates` checkbox.
- The gallery's "Navigation Concept" label passes its markup through `text` (`examples/component/gallery/MainContainer.mjs:199`), so the card prints `<b>Navigation Concept</b><p>…</p>` as text.
- "Sort by Lastname" and "Sort by Firstname" are `disabled: true` in the gallery (since 2021) and the helix (`examples/component/helix/Viewport.mjs:209`, `:217`), while all 590 records of `resources/examples/data/ai_contacts.json` carry `firstname` and `lastname`.
- At 390 × 844 the 260-px control panel takes two thirds of the width.
- The COVID pair reads `cvid_static_countries.json` from `neomjs/pages` (`useFallbackApi: true` in both `neo-config.json`), a snapshot of the disease.sh feed: a 2020 subject whose "Cases today" reads 0 on every card. #21166 moved the country grid off that feed to `examples/grid/countries/data/countries.json`: 217 economies, World Bank indicators retrieved 2026-11-17, CC BY 4.0.

## The Problem

A visitor who opens Lists & Galleries sees four cards whose frames show a counter at zero, a star button, raw tags and two disabled buttons, and two of them show a pandemic's numbers frozen in 2020. None of that is what Gallery and Helix are for: laying out a store's records in 3D, sorting them, and walking them by keyboard.

## The Architectural Reality

Design authority: #21367's terminal predicate, "every label drawn, focus where the page promises, nothing cut at 390 px, no card that opens on an error", and #21140's card count.

- `Neo.component.Gallery` and `Neo.component.Helix` build an item per record (`createItem`) and follow their store's sort.
- The countries file gives each record `flag` (ISO 3166 alpha-2), `country`, `region` and nine indicators. `Neo.util.CountryFlags.getFlagUrl()` resolves a code to its flag; `CountryGallery.mjs:115-173` maps names to flag images by hand.
- Records: `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` (family `lists`); recipes: `example-captures.json`; `seo.json`; covers ship in a `neomjs/pages` pull request. Count specs: `MainContainerController.spec.mjs`, `ExamplesCatalogNL.spec.mjs`.

## The Fix

- Gallery and helix: the counter, the star button and the `logDeltaUpdates` checkbox go; the Navigation Concept label renders its markup; both sort buttons are enabled and reorder the items; at 390 the component keeps the screen and the controls stay reachable.
- The COVID pair becomes a country pair on #21166's file, read where it lives: `examples/component/countryGallery` and `countryHelix` (ids `country-gallery`, `country-helix`). Each item shows the flag, the country and three indicators, and the page names its source. The snapshot fetch with its live-API branch and the name-to-flag table go.
- Records, recipes, SEO entries and covers for the four cards; the count specs follow.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: The two country pages load no COVID data. The gallery and the helix keep their DeltaUpdates counter, star button and `logDeltaUpdates` checkbox (the operator's review on #21458).
- [ ] AC-2: The gallery's Navigation Concept label renders as formatted text, no tag visible.
- [ ] AC-3: The helix's Sort by Lastname and Sort by Firstname sort by what they say once all 600 items render, and stay disabled below that, as the gallery's do: a partly rendered store does not animate its sorting.
- [ ] AC-4: The country gallery and helix show the 217 economies of `examples/grid/countries/data/countries.json`, each with its flag and three indicators, and name the World Bank as their source.
- [ ] AC-5: At 390 × 844 no card cuts a label or a control.
- [ ] AC-6: The four cards publish with covers taken after their content is drawn; the count specs follow.

## Out of Scope

- Part 2 of the group (above), filed after this leaf.
- Engine changes to Gallery or Helix beyond what a sort needs.

## Avoided Traps

- Keeping the COVID pair on its static Pages snapshot: it keeps 2020's numbers, "today" columns of zero included.
- A second copy of the countries file: one file keeps one source and one retrieval date for the grid and both pages.
